fields.name: name
fields.definition: Human-readable file name or logical object name.

fields.name: type
fields.definition: Declared file/object type; implementations must validate it against the actual object.

fields.name: id
fields.definition: Stable implementation-defined identifier for the file or copy set.

fields.name: definition
fields.definition: Optional concise description of the file's intended function.

fields.name: author
fields.definition: Declared author or provenance label; not an inferred identity.

fields.name: os_spawn
fields.definition: Operating-system installation or process context that created the file record.

fields.name: education_id
fields.definition: Optional project-defined reference to educational documentation or provenance; not a measure of a person.

fields.name: probable_scout_level
fields.definition: Optional declared project score describing expected alignment with documented conduct and educational objectives. It must be supplied by an authorized source or left unknown; it must not be inferred from sensitive personal data.

fields.name: hold_type
fields.definition: Extensible generic hold classification with no executable authority by itself.

fields.name: overall_health
fields.definition: Normalized file/copy integrity state: unknown, healthy, warning, degraded, or failed.

fields.name: content_identity
fields.definition: Content digest or equivalent identity used to compare physical copies.

fields.name: sense_ordinal
fields.definition: Physical copy/Sense number, constrained to 1, 2, or 3.

fields.name: source_device_id
fields.definition: Opaque identifier for the device supplying health evidence.

fields.name: health_evidence_source
fields.definition: Evidence source such as smart, nvme, scsi, filesystem-check, or unknown.

privacy: Person-related fields are optional provenance declarations and must never be automatically inferred from file content, filenames, ratings, or device data.
